sect1.title: Version X.Y.0 (date TBD)
sect1.para: This is a major update. The following new features were added:

listitem.para: Navebox GUI: Added a Phones page beside Machines for creating private Android SDK virtual devices, checking acceleration, starting and stopping phones, monitoring boot completion, and installing APKs. The main toolbar opens Create Phone and SDK Settings dialogs and enables device actions based on the selected phone. Each phone has an icon and state in the list, with configuration displayed beside it. Phone creation offers display and hardware profile variation for testing and a software-rendered cold boot. Phone actions can interrupt a status refresh.
Navebox GUI: Open the manager with expanded navigation and select Machines when available. Refine icons, spacing, and details panels in the Machines and Phones views.
Navebox for Windows: Branded the installed executables, VM library, translations, SDK files and global settings filename. Updated file associations and retained access to existing settings
Navebox GUI: Unified the appearance of Manager pages and refreshed the Notifications, menu bar, and status bar sheets
Navebox GUI: Fixed a crash when opening Phones and restored the navigation colors used before the Manager page refresh
Navebox GUI: Added consistent page headers, refined tables and tabs, and rounded scrollbars to the Manager
Navebox GUI: Keep the Home backdrop across Manager tabs, contain toolbar hover fills, align menu chevrons, and soften scrollbar colors
Navebox GUI: Place Manager menus and colored window controls in the Windows title bar, and show the product identity and a two-state collapse control in the left navigation

Navebox GUI: Redesigned Home with an illustrated header and keyboard-accessible rows for common VM actions and help resources. Refined the light palette, softened dividers, and aligned the toolbar with the Home card
Navebox GUI: Combined About, contact details, build information, and credits in one scrollable dialog.

Building the OSE Edition: Implemented a new configure.py script which unifies the ./configure (non-Windows) and configure.vbs (Windows) scripts Please adjust your building process accordingly, as the compatibility wrapper scripts ./configure and configure.vbs are now marked as being deprecated and will be removed in a future version of VirtualBox.

sect1.para: In addition, the following items were fixed or added:

listitem.para: VMM: Fixed an assertion during guest startup when repeated exit-history probes completed without observing an exit
Windows installer: Included staged Qt libraries and required plugins when building Navebox with the public Qt SDK payload

Windows installer: Applied Navebox product metadata, setup artwork, distributor information and localized product references while retaining original component licenses and compatible service identifiers
BIOS: Replaced the default guest boot splash with the Navebox identity while retaining custom boot images and the F12 boot menu
GUI: Introduced Navebox branding, desktop icons and product information with a separate About action next to Help, and replaced heavy native input and group-box frames with lighter borders

GUI: Restored distinct mouse capture and integration status icons, updated all About text when changing languages and link colors when changing themes, and added copying of build information for support

GUI: Updated the Navebox folded-ribbon logo and blue action icons, centered dialogs within the visible owner or screen area and showed startup errors in a separate centered window instead of displaying About behind the error
Navebox GUI: Center dialogs using their own window frame.
GUI: Removed unused preview frame bitmaps and their display-scale limitation, and included the Navebox launcher and matching shortcuts in Windows installer packages

GUI: Refreshed application action and status icons with scalable glass artwork and lighter visual weight, and made the Manager toolbar, machine list and details cards more compact, using the application theme colors. Simplified Settings navigation, page surfaces and the Basic/Expert selector
GUI: Handled accessibility queries while the Manager machine list is being initialized or closed
GUI: Improved Settings dialog responsiveness by using native disabled-control rendering instead of striped widget masks
GUI: Fixed Settings dialog freezes and crashes when Windows accessibility clients navigate or retain menu bar editor buttons
NAT: Fixed ICMP traceroute missing intermediate hops when using NAT networking
VBoxManage: Added natnetwork log and dhcpserver log commands to display NAT network and DHCP server log files

VBoxManage: Added new 'clipboard' sub command for controlling the Shared Clipboard along with other new features such as listening for clipboard events or copying / pasting clipboard data. Verbose clipboard event output reports non-UTF-8/UTF-16 payloads as binary data with their size. The 'modifyvm' clipboard options are now marked as being deprecated.

Shared Clipboard: Fixed plain-text copy and paste on macOS hosts and improved VBoxManage clipboard listen event and payload output, including compact logfmt-style human records and a startup warning when Shared Clipboard is disabled
